title: workspace fallback seams in daemon enumerated for phase 2 and 3
summary:
P1 instrumented every daemon.js seam that silently falls through to state.workspace when no explicit workspace is passed. Exhaustive categorization of the ~51 state.workspace occurrences (this is the contract P2b/P3 consume so no caller is missed):

SILENT-FALLBACK SEAMS (warned, must be cut over in P2b/P3):
1. targetOverlay(b,u) (daemon.js ~L431) — central write-route funnel; ALL write routes (routes/git, routes/graph, routes/exec, routes/config, routes/classify, routes/analytics + lib/dispatcher-*, lib/classify-compose, lib/usage-reconcile) resolve workspace here. Warns only when neither body.workspace nor ?workspace= present.
2. sweepStaleClaims (~L608), sweepFailedTasks (~L634), sweepStaleVerdicts (~L677), sweepStaleGuidance (~L724), sweepFiledropStubs (~L1580) — each defaulted ws=state.workspace; now sentinel-default + warn when called with no ws. Internal callers (decideAll L1180-82, buildGraph L1730, boot sweeps L2323/L2343) already pass explicit ws (silent).
3. decideOne loop tick (~L962) — ctx.ws||state.workspace; warns when ctx.ws absent (legacy ctx only).

LEGITIMATE EXPLICIT-RESOLUTION USES (no warning needed — NOT fallbacks):
- Boot pin: loadState L342-346 (reads WS_FILE into state.workspace) and POST /workspace L2044 — these SET the pointer, the thing P3 deprecates at source.
- Daemon-own-overlay coherence checks: every `(ws===state.workspace)?state.overlay:overlayStore.load(ws)` (L93, L432, L790, L1179, L1197, L1601, L1726, L1601, L2322) — these receive ws already-resolved; they pick in-memory overlay vs fresh-load, not a fallback.
- Per-workspace UNION loops: decideAll L1176-77, boot sweeps L2320/L2342, sweepStaleLoops L789 (L.workspace||state.workspace) — state.workspace is one MEMBER of the active-workspace set, intentional.
- resolveRepo L419 / releaseClaim L493 / sweepStaleClaims internal stWs L611 / stopSignalFor L844/L865 / applyOptimize L920 / verdictsFor/pendingOptimizeProblem L881/L896 — parameterized helpers defaulting to current overlay; t
